card.name: Separators before numbers and codes
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces, or short letters that sit between two numeric or code-like items, such as a colon in a ratio, a space between dose ranges, or a flag letter in a command. It fires where a figure or code is about to follow.

modes.label: Space or colon in dose figures
modes.description: A space or colon between numbers, units or ratios in dose tables and mixing instructions.
modes.example: 700 mg 40 mL b 30 mL to 135 mL<< >>70 mL to 175

modes.label: Colon after a label
modes.description: A colon after a measurement label or list heading, just before the values or examples.

modes.label: Command flags and chemical codes
modes.description: A single letter or hyphenated piece inside a command option or chemical name.
